description: bitFlyer FX_BTC_JPY funding-fee (swap) rate history, consumed alongside flow_FX_BTC_JPY.csv by the storm-radar research scripts (scripts/research_storm.py, scripts/research_storm_direction.py) to check whether funding-rate regime interacts with storm events.
source: not produced by a fetch script in this repo (no scripts/fetch_*.py writes this path) -- appears to be an owner-maintained/hand-updated record of bitFlyer's FX_BTC_JPY funding fee calendar. Verify against bitFlyer's public funding-fee announcement page before assuming this auto-refreshes.
retention: appended forward; exact update mechanism unconfirmed (see source note above).

calculation_date.meaning: date/time the funding rate was calculated
calculation_date.unit: ISO-8601 (no explicit UTC offset in the raw string)
calculation_date.tz: unconfirmed -- read alongside settlement_date, which scripts/research_storm.py explicitly parses with pandas utc=True

settlement_date.meaning: date/time the funding fee was applied/settled
settlement_date.tz: treated as UTC by consuming scripts (pd.to_datetime(..., utc=True))
settlement_date.notes: this is the column consuming scripts sort/index on, not calculation_date

rate.meaning: funding fee rate for the period

known_defects: no fetch script in this repo currently writes this file -- provenance/update cadence is not verifiable from the code alone; treat any gap or staleness claim about this file cautiously until the actual update process is confirmed with the owner
calculation_date's timezone is not explicit in the raw string; only settlement_date is consistently treated as UTC by downstream code
